annotations.title: I Ching Hexagram Lookup (六十四卦)

description:
Use this when you need to identify or describe a hexagram, convert between its number, name, trigram pair and line pattern, or find its derived hexagrams and palace position. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you have moving lines and need the changed hexagram and reading rule (use hexagram-change), or you need to cast a hexagram from a date or numbers (use meihua-yishu).
What it computes: Identifies one of the 64 hexagrams (六十四卦, liushisi gua) from its King Wen number, name, two trigrams or line digits and returns its lines, trigrams, nuclear (互卦, hugua), inverse (综卦, zonggua) and opposite (错卦, cuogua) hexagrams, its Jing Fang palace (京房八宫, Jingfang bagong) with 世/应 (shi/ying) lines, and the received judgment text (卦辞, guaci).
Inputs: king_wen_number (integer, optional); name (string, optional); upper_trigram (string, optional); lower_trigram (string, optional); lines (string, optional).
Valid input combinations: Identify the hexagram with king_wen_number, name, lines, or the complete upper_trigram + lower_trigram pair. Multiple identification methods may be supplied when they agree.
Complete JSON argument examples: {"king_wen_number":1} | {"lines":"100010"}
Outputs: number, name_cn, full_name_cn, pinyin, english, symbol, lines, lines_text, upper_trigram, lower_trigram, nuclear_hexagram, inverse_hexagram, opposite_hexagram, palace, palace_position, shi_line, ying_line, judgment_text, sequence_pair, binary_value, notes.
Formula: lower trigram = lines 1–3, upper trigram = lines 4–6; nuclear = lines 2,3,4 + 3,4,5; inverse = reversed line order; opposite = each line flipped; binary_value = Σ line_i · 2^(i−1); 应 = 世 ± 3
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/hexagram-lookup with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/yijing/hexagram-lookup.md

inputSchema.description: Identify the hexagram with king_wen_number, name, lines, or the complete upper_trigram + lower_trigram pair. Multiple identification methods may be supplied when they agree.

king_wen_number.description: Hexagram number 1–64 in the King Wen sequence (1 = 乾, 64 = 未济). Give exactly one of king_wen_number, name, lines or the trigram pair.

lines.description: Six digits from line 1 (bottom) to line 6 (top): 1/0 for yang/yin, or 6/7/8/9 (老阴/少阳/少阴/老阳) as produced by yarrow or coin casting.

lower_trigram.description: Lower (inner) trigram, in any form accepted by bagua.

name.description: Chinese name (屯, 水雷屯, 乾为天; traditional forms accepted), pinyin (zhun; ambiguous pinyin such as qian or bi is rejected with the candidates) or Wilhelm/Baynes title (Difficulty at the Beginning).

upper_trigram.description: Upper (outer) trigram, in any form accepted by bagua (坎, kan, water, ☵, 010). Must be given together with lower_trigram.

name: lookup_iching_hexagram

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

binary_value.description: Integer of the six bits with the top line as the most significant bit (乾 = 63, 坤 = 0).

full_name_cn.description: Traditional descriptive name with the trigram images, e.g. 水雷屯 or 乾为天.

inverse_hexagram.description: The hexagram turned upside down (lines reversed).

judgment_text.description: Received classical judgment text of the 周易 (Zhouyi), simplified characters.

lines.description: Six digits from line 1 to line 6; 1 = yang, 0 = yin.

lines_text.description: Traditional line titles from bottom to top, e.g. 初九 六二 … 上六.

lower_trigram.description: Inner trigram (lines 1–3) with pinyin, symbol and nature.

number.description: Position 1–64 in the King Wen sequence.

palace.description: Jing Fang (京房) palace the hexagram belongs to, with its element.

palace_position.description: 本宫 / 一世 … 五世 / 游魂 / 归魂 position within the palace.

sequence_pair.description: Partner hexagram in the King Wen pairing (2n−1, 2n): its inverse, or its opposite for the eight symmetric hexagrams.

shi_line.description: Position (1–6) of the 世 line: 6 for the palace hexagram, 1–5 for generations 1–5, 4 for 游魂, 3 for 归魂.

upper_trigram.description: Outer trigram (lines 4–6) with pinyin, symbol and nature.

ying_line.description: Position of the 应 line, three lines away from 世.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.
